_doc: Where markings can go on the pitch. Rounds (rounds/*.json) put a sponsor in a position by name.
Metres. x runs along the pitch from halfway (10 m lines at +-10..+-40, try lines +-50, dead-ball lines +-58);
z runs across it from the middle (touchlines +-34). The main broadcast camera is on the +z touchline, so +z is
the near side. x/z are the centre of the marking; along = size along the pitch, across = size across it.
broadcast_stretch: grass logos are painted longer across the pitch than they look, because the camera sees
that direction foreshortened (stock logos are ~1.38x). Art is drawn to look right AFTER that stretch.
host (what the game draws it with - one per round unless noted):
centre     the round model's centre logo quad (centre = squarish logos, centre_wide = long ones)
squares_a  two quads (both halves, mirrored at +-x)
squares_b  two more quads (both halves, mirrored at +-x)
in_goal    both in-goals, as flat panels across the field (panels_z = panel centres, length across, depth along)
layer      an extra model drawn on top - any number per round, one quad each
A round can override x / z / along / across (or the in-goal panel layout) for a position in its own slot.
